# Vector Arcade

Browser arcade with Stripe coin purchases and an x402 API for AI agents.
Source code is publicly available at no charge.

## Status

The payment Worker may be offline or undeployed. Check discovery before
attempting any purchase. A 404 or 503 indicates the Worker is unavailable.
The arcade frontend operates in demo mode when the Worker is unreachable.

## Games

- MARINEO: Vector platformer
- WIREFRAME CITYSHOOTER: First-person shooter
- HEX FRONTLINE: Tactical strategy
- VECTOR ORB FALL: Arcade action
- VECTOR DUEL RONDE: Fighting game
- BLOOD CRYPT: Diablo-inspired dungeon crawler (Phaser 3)

## Human Purchases

Buy coins via Stripe checkout at the lobby. 1 coin = 7 minutes of play.
The lobby shows [ONLINE] or [OFFLINE] status in the footer.

## Agent Purchases

The agent product is a structured integration blueprint, not game coins.

- Source: https://github.com/KG-NINJA/Vector-Arcade
- Discovery: https://vector-arcade-coins.fuwafuwow.workers.dev/.well-known/x402
- OpenAPI: https://vector-arcade-coins.fuwafuwow.workers.dev/openapi.json
- Purchase: https://vector-arcade-coins.fuwafuwow.workers.dev/x402/vector-arcade-system

Read discovery before paying. A 503 indicates sales are unavailable.
After an uncertain settlement, do not issue another payment.

## Requirements for Live Sales

1. Worker must be deployed to Cloudflare
2. Worker routes/custom domain must be bound
3. GET /.well-known/x402 must return 200
4. For x402: X402_ENABLED=true and valid payTo/facilitator required
